item.title: Thomas Modeneis
item.description:
I help companies design, build, and run the backend systems that sit on the critical path of real-time requests: matching engines, market-data and price streams, real-time bidding, search, and data APIs.

I have 22 years of software engineering behind me, in roles from founder and CTO to architect and hands-on engineer. I co-founded Vosbor Exchange and built its trading backend from zero, was Chief Architect of Hydration (formerly HydraDX) on Polkadot, and led engineering of the matching and market-data platform at Sphinx (SPHX). Earlier, I built William Hill’s Product Data Service, the system behind every sports price change and bet, and Coull’s OpenRTB bid switch for video advertising.

item.title: Ivens Signorini
item.description:
I am a Senior Backend Engineer with more than 20 years of experience shipping production systems, from mission-critical banking and consumer-credit platforms to Go services for trading and AI start-ups.

I work mainly in Go, Java, and Python, on Kubernetes. I have written Java since 2005 and Go since 2016.

For six years I was technical lead of the private-label credit card platform of one of Brazil’s largest fashion retailers, a high-volume consumer-credit system. At Banco Santander I worked on the systems integration for its acquisition of Banco Real, and I have led migrations from legacy monoliths to services in Java and Spring.
